links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient-facing answers versus recommended patient material level
links.effect: Bard high school level and ChatGPT college level, versus a 4th to 6th grade goal; Bard significantly easier than ChatGPT (P<0.001).
links.quote: Bard readability scores were high school level, significantly easier than ChatGPT's college level by all scoring metrics (P <0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, quality, and readability of ChatGPT and Bard on patient-facing questions about labor epidurals without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
